name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15.plr_hop
title: Open: the PLR hop of the positional masked gamma-tensor GGH15 WE candidate (PR #54)
statement: Positional masked gamma-tensor GGH15 (secrets diag(P^(t)_{i,b} (x) R_i, M_{i,b} (x) S'_{i,b}, S_{i,b}) with the reflected-Gray comparator P^(t) against threshold t, CNF branching program M of CVW18 Construction 6.4, final comparator rows mask' on lt and mask on eq/gt, published (J_O A_0, J_C A_0, {D_{i,b}}, (r_0 R_*) mask)). If the path of Gray rank t < 2^h does not satisfy Psi and decision LWE has k bits at parameters pL in the CVW18 regime, then every machine distinguishing hybrid t from hybrid t+1 has 2^k * gain <= hopLoss(h, rows)^2 * (cost + simCost): the hop loses poly(h) * eps_LWE.
